cd "/Users/karolinegriesbach/Documents/Innkeepr/Git/evaluation-and-execution-scripts/Analysis/DTW_Incidents" && python3 << 'PY'
import re, zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = {"m": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"}

def sheet_to_rows(z, path, max_rows=5):
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read(path))
    rows_out = []
    for row in root.findall(".//m:sheetData/m:row", NS):
        cells = {}
        for c in row.findall("m:c", NS):
            ref = c.attrib.get("r", "")
            col = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)", ref).group(1)
            t = c.attrib.get("t")
            if t == "inlineStr":
                is_el = c.find("m:is/m:t", NS)
                val = is_el.text if is_el is not None else None
            else:
                v = c.find("m:v", NS)
                val = v.text if v is not None else None
            cells[col] = val
        # order by column letters
        cols = sorted(cells, key=lambda x: (len(x), x))
        rows_out.append([cells.get(c) for c in cols])
        if len(rows_out) >= max_rows:
            break
    return rows_out

with zipfile.ZipFile("2026-07-20-dtw_incident_analysis-2.xlsx") as z:
    # sheet names from workbook
    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    sheets = [(s.attrib["name"], s.attrib["{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id"]) for s in wb.findall(".//{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}sheet")]
    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
    rid_to_target = {r.attrib["Id"]: r.attrib["Target"] for r in rels}
    for name, rid in sheets:
        target = "xl/" + rid_to_target[rid].lstrip("/")
        if target.startswith("xl/xl/"):
            target = target[3:]
        print(f"\n=== {name} ({target}) ===")
        for r in sheet_to_rows(z, target, max_rows=4):
            print(r)

cd "/Users/karolinegriesbach/Documents/Innkeepr/Git/evaluation-and-execution-scripts" && python3 << 'PY'
import pandas as pd

dtw_daily = pd.read_csv("Analysis/DTW_Incidents/2026-07-20-dtw_incident_daily-3.csv")
dtw_daily["date"] = pd.to_datetime(dtw_daily["date"])
dtw_daily["is_incident"] = dtw_daily["is_incident"].astype(bool)
dtw_daily["week"] = dtw_daily["date"].dt.isocalendar().week.astype(int)
dtw_daily["year"] = dtw_daily["date"].dt.isocalendar().year.astype(int)

weekly_incidents = (
    dtw_daily.groupby(
        by=["account_name", "audience_id", "model_type", "year", "week"],
        as_index=False,
    )
    .agg(
        incident_days=("is_incident", "sum"),
        total_days=("is_incident", "count"),
    )
)
weekly_incidents["incident_days"] = weekly_incidents["incident_days"].astype(int)
weekly_incidents = weekly_incidents.sort_values(
    by=["account_name", "audience_id", "model_type", "year", "week"]

# DTW Analyis

import pandas as pd

dtw_daily["is_incident"] = dtw_daily["is_incident"].astype(bool)
dtw_daily["week"] = dtw_daily["date"].dt.isocalendar().week.astype(int)
dtw_daily["year"] = dtw_daily["date"].dt.isocalendar().year.astype(int)
dtw_daily.head()

--- cell 3 (markdown) ---
## Weekly incident counts

Sum of incident days per week, per account / audience / model type.

--- cell 4 (code) ---
weekly_incidents = (
    dtw_daily.groupby(
        by=["account_name", "audience_id", "model_type", "year", "week"],
        as_index=False,
    )
    .agg(
        incident_days=("is_incident", "sum"),
        total_days=("is_incident", "count"),
    )
)
weekly_incidents["incident_days"] = weekly_incidents["incident_days"].astype(int)
weekly_incidents["is_incident"] = weekly_incidents["incident_days"] > 0
weekly_incidents = weekly_incidents.sort_values(
    by=["account_name", "audience_id", "model_type", "year", "week"]
).reset_index(drop=True)
weekly_incidents

import json
from pathlib import Path

path = Path("Analysis/DTW_Incidents/2026-07-20-incidend-analysis.ipynb")

        by=["account_name", "year", "week"],

weekly_incidents_workspaces["x-axis"] = (
    weekly_incidents_workspaces["year"].astype(str)

    + weekly_incidents_workspaces["week"].astype(str).str.zfill(2)
)
weekly_incidents_workspaces = weekly_incidents_workspaces.sort_values(
    by=["year", "week"]
).reset_index(drop=True)

n_accounts = weekly_incidents_workspaces["account_name"].nunique()
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", context="notebook")
palette = sns.color_palette("husl", n_colors=n_accounts)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 6))
sns.lineplot(
    data=weekly_incidents_workspaces,
    x="x-axis",
    y="is_incident",
    hue="account_name",
    palette=palette,
    marker="o",
    linewidth=2,
    errorbar=None,
    ax=ax,
)
ax.set_title("Weekly incident rate by workspace")
ax.set_xlabel("Year-Week")
ax.set_ylabel("Incident rate")
ax.set_ylim(-0.05, 1.05)
ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=90)
ax.legend(
    title="Account",
    bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1),
    loc="upper left",
    frameon=False,
)
sns.despine()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
'''

# find the cell with the lineplot
for i, c in enumerate(nb["cells"]):
    src = "".join(c.get("source", []))
    if "sns.lineplot" in src or "weekly_incidents_workspaces" in src:
        print(f"updating cell {i}")
        print("OLD:", src[:200])
        nb["cells"][i]["source"] = [line + "\n" for line in new_source.split("\n")]
        # remove trailing newline-only last empty from split
        if nb["cells"][i]["source"] and nb["cells"][i]["source"][-1] == "\n":
            nb["cells"][i]["source"][-1] = ""
        # cleaner: write lines properly
        lines = new_source.splitlines(keepends=True)
        if lines and not lines[-1].endswith("\n"):
            pass
        nb["cells"][i]["source"] = lines
        nb["cells"][i]["outputs"] = []
        nb["cells"][i]["execution_count"] = None
        break
else:
